## What changed

Briefly describe the character, relationship, source or correction; one sentence is enough for a small change.

## Sources and versions

Original link, timestamp or comment context; the actual scope checked; how other versions are kept.
For pure formatting or typo fixes you may write "no canon changes".
When images are included, state the entry or display purpose each image relates to, plus the original source and rights status; generic material collections are submitted as text indexes and external links only.

## Before submitting

- [ ] In-video canon, creator's supplements, comment co-creation, inferences and original writing are distinguished; nothing is invented where there is no evidence.
- [ ] New or renamed entries have updated the indexes, and version differences in relationships are preserved.
- [ ] Images or short GIFs, if any, state the setting they help explain or the display purpose; generic material collections use indexes and external links and are not committed as whole packages.
- [ ] No private information or credentials are included; you agree to share contributions you have the right to license under CC BY-SA 4.0.
- [ ] Documentation checks have been run, or you are waiting for the automatic PR checks.
